title: lab 104 - 2026
description: AWS IAM Users, Groups, and Policies

objectives: Create and manage IAM users and groups.
Assign permissions using AWS managed policies.
Apply the Principle of Least Privilege.
Differentiate between Full Access, Read-only, and Service-specific policies.
Understand why permissions should be managed through groups rather than individual users.
Interpret effective permissions when users belong to multiple groups.

tasks.title: Explore IAM Policy Types
steps: Navigate to IAM and click on Policies
find policies - 1) 'AmazonEC2FullAccess', 2) 'AmazonS3FullAccess', 3) 'ReadOnlyAccess'
Now determine - 1) 'AWS Managed or Customer Managed', 2) 'Number of attached entities', 3) 'Policy Version'
Keep record of above findings

tasks.title: Create 'Support Team' Group
steps: Create a new group named SupportTeam
Attach 'AmazonEC2ReadOnlyAccess' policy to 'SupportTeam' group
Create user 'support1'
Assign user 'support1' to 'SupportTeam' group

tasks.title: Verify 'support1' User Permissions
steps: validate - if above user can'View EC2'
expected result -  Allowed
check - if user can 'Launch EC2'
expected result - 'Denied'
verify - if above mentioned user ca 'Terminate EC2'
expected result -  'Denied'

tasks.title: Challenge I - Manage Access of developer user
steps: create user 'developer1' and without creating a new policy manage his permissions
permissions required - 1) user can launch EC2, 2) user cannot manage S3, 3) user cannot manage IAM
Hint - Use an existing AWS managed policy. Remember 'developer1' is a member of developers group should exist

tasks.title: Challenge II - Manage access of Intern user
steps: create user 'intern1' and without creating a new policy manage his permissions
permissions required - 1) user can View everything, 2) Cannot create anything, 3) Cannot delete anything
Hint - Use an existing AWS managed policy. Remember 'intern1' is a member of 'interns' group

tasks.title: Challenge III - Manage Backup Administrator Access
steps: create user 'backupadmin1' and Without creating a new policy manage this user's permissions
permissions required - 1) Full S3 Access, 2) Read-only EC2, 3) No IAM access
Hint - Use an existing AWS managed policy. Remember 'backupadmin1' is a member of 'backupadmins' group
